chapter: Dance jobs and the opera house
title: The French Opera House and Navy band instruments
summary: Dejan first went to the French Opera House with Paul Moyer and Sammy Hopkins; he also lists the many horns he played in Navy bands, and says he played at the opera house bar three years.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: On the corner of Toulouse and Boevin. Oh, French Opera House ball.

I was sitting on my step. I told my wife, I said, after I come out to Navy, you know, well, sticking to that music so hard, I mean, blowing so much. I was playing baritone with one of the concerted bands. I was playing baritone and clarinet with the big orchestra. I was playing tenor with the parade band. And I was playing tenor with one of the concerted bands. And I was playing alto in my Dixieland band. See, I had a Dixieland band. And the chief, sometime we had to play a crew dance. And the dance with officers Sam Knight, where the chief would take the band, the big band, I'd take the Dixieland band and go play for the crew.
Now, this was the Opera House bar, but one is still there.
It's still there. Yeah. I played there about three years, every night.
